deep_analysis = """import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('/workspace/testbed/data/order_summary.xlsx')

# --- Status breakdown ---
print("=== ORDER STATUS BREAKDOWN ===")
status_counts = df['Status'].value_counts()

print(status_totals.to_string())

# --- Customer breakdown ---
print("\\n=== TOP CUSTOMERS BY ORDER COUNT ===")
cust = df.groupby('Customer')['Total Paid'].agg(['count','sum','mean']).sort_values('count', ascending=False)
print(cust.to_string())

# --- Customer breakdown (confirmed only) ---
print("\\n=== TOP CUSTOMERS BY CONFIRMED REVENUE ===")
confirmed = df[df['Status'] == 'confirmed']
cust_conf = confirmed.groupby('Customer')['Total Paid'].agg(['count','sum','mean']).sort_values('sum', ascending=False)
print(cust_conf.to_string())

# --- Date breakdown ---
print("\\n=== ORDERS BY DATE ===")
date_agg = df.groupby('Date')['Total Paid'].agg(['count','sum','mean'])
print(date_agg.to_string())

# --- Product frequency (explode Items column) ---
print("\\n=== MOST FREQUENTLY ORDERED PRODUCTS ===")
items_exploded = df['Items'].str.split(', ').explode().str.strip()
product_freq = items_exploded.value_counts()
print(product_freq.to_string())

# --- Product frequency (confirmed only) ---
print("\\n=== MOST FREQUENTLY ORDERED PRODUCTS (CONFIRMED ONLY) ===")
confirmed_items = confirmed['Items'].str.split(', ').explode().str.strip()
conf_product_freq = confirmed_items.value_counts()
print(conf_product_freq.to_string())

# --- Cancelled orders detail ---
print("\\n=== CANCELLED ORDERS ===")
cancelled = df[df['Status'] == 'cancelled']
print(cancelled[['Order ID','Customer','Items','Total Paid']].to_string())

# --- Orders with multiple items ---
df['Item Count'] = df['Items'].str.split(', ').apply(len)
print("\\n=== ITEM COUNT DISTRIBUTION ===")
print(df['Item Count'].value_counts().sort_index().to_string())

print("\\n=== AVERAGE ORDER VALUE BY ITEM COUNT ===")
print(df.groupby('Item Count')['Total Paid'].agg(['count','mean','sum']).to_string())
"""
await write_file("./deep_analysis.py", deep_analysis)
